supporting_observations.claim: FILE-SUN-01's Arcvault agent ran as svc-store with the command line specifying the Nightly job and the approved Arcvault ingest destination; the proxy then recorded a 640,000,000-byte client-to-server transfer to that destination.
The large transfer is consistent with the inventory's approved Arcvault backup agent and its expected several-hundred-MB uploads, which supports a benign explanation.

Shortly before the backup agent ran, a domain-controller Kerberos record for svc-store listed source IP 45.79.19.196; a svc-store service logon on FILE-SUN-01 followed. This source and timing warrant checking whether the account activity was authorized.

The records do not place the 640,000,000-byte proxy transfer at the alert's approximate 13:46 time: the transfer is logged at 13:49:57. At 13:45:55, FILE-SUN-01 instead made a TLS connection to WS-ZADAMS-01 with 4,014 origin bytes recorded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available transfer records show byte counts and destination, but not the contents or business purpose of the uploaded data.
The records do not establish why the svc-store Kerberos event lists 45.79.19.196 as its source or whether that activity was authorized.
The alert's approximate time is not matched by a hundreds-of-MB transfer record in the supplied logs; the large proxy transfer is recorded several minutes later.
claims_not_established: Whether the alert refers to the 13:49:57 Arcvault transfer or to a separate transfer around 13:46.
Whether the 640,000,000 bytes were expected backup data or unauthorized data.
Whether the svc-store authentication from 45.79.19.196 was legitimate, and whether it was causally related to the Arcvault transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Alert metadata and network-flow records identifying the precise transfer time, destination, and flow associated with the alert.
Arcvault job and service-account audit records confirming the Nightly job, expected upload volume, and whether the 13:49 run was scheduled.
Domain-controller and network evidence to validate the source and legitimacy of the svc-store Kerberos activity recorded from 45.79.19.196.
Endpoint evidence identifying the data collected or staged by the Arcvault agent for this upload.
unrelated_findings: Help-desk user lena.ward initiated an RDP session to FILE-SUN-01 and logged on there. This is outside the alerted transfer based on the available records and should be reviewed separately against the stated remote-administration practice. (T230-00272, T230-00278, T230-00281, T230-00285)
FILE-SUN-01 queried status-monitor.app, which is not among the approved services listed in the environment context. The records do not link this query to the large transfer. (T230-00009, T230-00011)

FILE-SUN-01 generated failed logons for the disabled account svc_mgmt, including an SMB-related attempt to DC-SUN-01. The records do not link these failures to the large transfer. (T230-00492, T230-00496, T230-00497)
